new.x: Angel Falls on the Churun in Venezuela's Guiana Highlands is the highest at about 979 m. Tugela (South Africa) is the second highest, Victoria (Zambezi) is the largest sheet of falling water and Iguazu (Argentina-Brazil) is the largest fall system.

1. It is a meromictic sea.
2. Its salinity is about 17-18 ppt.
3. Iran is one of its bordering countries.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct: the Black Sea is meromictic (its layers do not mix). Statement 2 is correct: its salinity is about 17-18 ppt. Statement 3 is wrong: it is bordered by Turkey, Bulgaria, Romania, Ukraine, Russia and Georgia; Iran borders the Caspian. Hence 1 and 2 only.
new.tq: Black Sea neighbours: Turkey, Bulgaria, Romania, Ukraine, Russia, Georgia - no Iran.

o: It passes through northern Andhra Pradesh.

new.x: The Tropic of Cancer roughly divides India into two halves. Present Andhra Pradesh (12°41' N - 19°07' N) lies wholly south of it, so it does not pass through AP. It is neither India's southern limit nor north of the mainland.
new.tq: AP tops out at 19°07' N - south of the Tropic (23.5° N).

new.s: The 2023-24 remeasurement that placed India's coastline at 11,098.81 km was carried out by:
o: the Geological Survey of India and ISRO
the National Hydrographic Office and the Survey of India
the Indian Coast Guard and the Ministry of Earth Sciences

new.x: The National Hydrographic Office and the Survey of India carried out the remeasurement, and the Ministry of Home Affairs reported it in December 2024. The figure rose from 7,516.6 km because of finer 1:250,000 GIS tracing, not land growth. The other agencies are not credited with it.
new.tq: 11,098.81 km = NHO + Survey of India, reported by MHA (Dec 2024).

A. Gandak
B. Son
C. Kosi

new.x: Below Prayagraj the order is Tons, Gomti, Ghaghara, Son, Gandak, Kosi and Mahananda. So Ghaghara (D), Son (B), Gandak (A), Kosi (C): D, B, A, C. The other codes misplace the Son or the Ghaghara.
new.tq: Tons-Gomti-Ghaghara-Son-Gandak-Kosi-Mahananda: only Tons and Son come from the right.
